CustomField.description: When true, the formTemplate LWC renders this Form Template as a non-linear Stages view (a stepper showing all pages with status, time estimate, and per-stage action). When false, the form renders with the existing linear page-by-page navigation.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Render this Form Template as a non-linear stepper (Form Stages view) where respondents see all pages at once and can jump between them. Leave unchecked for the default linear page-by-page navigation.
CustomField.label: Stages Mode
